kaels_father.text: The light needs tending while you're gone. I'll keep it burning.
kaels_father.speaker: Father

kaels_father.text: Your mother always said the fog remembers what we forget.
kaels_father.speaker: Father

aldwyn_mirefall.text: Kael. I found this at the university — someone mailed it anonymously from Ashenveil Vale, months ago.
aldwyn_mirefall.speaker: Aldwyn

aldwyn_mirefall.text: It's your mother's field journal. The last pages describe something beneath the Ashveil Hollow. Something dreaming.
aldwyn_mirefall.speaker: Aldwyn

aldwyn_mirefall.text: Take one of these Pokémon. You'll need a partner where you're going.
aldwyn_mirefall.speaker: Aldwyn

aldwyn_mirefall.text: The journal's incomplete. But it points toward Cinderpeak first. Be careful.
aldwyn_mirefall.speaker: Aldwyn

aldwyn_mirefall_repeat.text: The fog's been thin lately. Watch yourself on Route 2.
aldwyn_mirefall_repeat.speaker: Aldwyn

sable_mirefall.text: Oh. You're actually going. I thought you'd stay and polish the lighthouse or something.
sable_mirefall.speaker: Sable

mirefall_villager_dock.text: The fishing's been strange lately. Tentacool won't come near the harbor.
The Veil's different too. Thinner, somehow. Like something's missing.

mirefall_elder.text: I remember when the fog was so thick you couldn't see your hand at arm's length. Now look at it.
They say the mist remembers the dead. I hope that's not all it remembers.

route2_sign.text: ROUTE 2 — Watch for Growlithe in the tall grass. They bite.

route2_hiker.text: Heading to Cinderpeak? The forge town. They say the gym leader there came up through the same fire she trains with.
Don't let her Arcanine rattle you. Keep your head.

growlithe_first_encounter.text: A Growlithe crouches behind a rock. A burn scar runs across its left flank.
It watches you with cautious eyes. It doesn't flee — but it doesn't come closer either.
Maybe if you had something to offer...

pokecenter_nurse.text: Welcome. Your Pokémon look like they've been through it.
pokecenter_nurse.speaker: Nurse

pokecenter_nurse.text: Let me take care of them.
pokecenter_nurse.speaker: Nurse

cinderpeak_worker.text: Garnet's been in the gym for three days straight. She does that before a challenger comes.
She knows things, that woman. Don't ask me how.

cinderpeak_child.text: Nobody beats Garnet on their first try. Nobody.

gym_gate_guard.text: The Ember Badge waits inside. Show Garnet what you've got.
gym_gate_guard.speaker: Guard

gym_gate_guard_block.text: You can't challenge the gym without a Pokémon. Go see Professor Aldwyn in Mirefall.
gym_gate_guard_block.speaker: Guard

garnet_pre_battle.text: You've come a long way from Mirefall. I can see it in how you stand.
garnet_pre_battle.speaker: Garnet

garnet_pre_battle.text: Your mother came through here. She was looking for something worth protecting.
garnet_pre_battle.speaker: Garnet

garnet_pre_battle.text: I wonder if you've found it yet.
garnet_pre_battle.speaker: Garnet

garnet_pre_battle.text: Let's see what you're made of. I won't hold back.
garnet_pre_battle.speaker: Garnet

garnet_post_battle.text: The Ember Badge is yours. You've earned it.
garnet_post_battle.speaker: Garnet

garnet_post_battle.text: That Pokémon of yours — it trusts you. Don't forget that's what makes the difference.
garnet_post_battle.speaker: Garnet

garnet_post_battle.text: The road north gets harder. Whatever your mother found up there... be ready for it.
garnet_post_battle.speaker: Garnet
